C1206.title: Scanning QR Code Login: How Fake QR Codes Steal Accounts via CSDN Blog
C1206.summary: The referenced material explains that QR-code login commonly relies on temporary tokens, scan confirmation, and server-side polling. If attackers forge a login scenario and induce users to scan a malicious QR code, they can exploit the fact that users cannot visually inspect the QR content, enabling phishing that may steal login sessions or hijack accounts. QR-code login itself is a common authentication method; the risk comes from attackers replacing the login context, impersonating a trusted entry point, and inducing users to authorize a session. Platforms need to verify device, source, and session state together.
